CME 16:15-16:30 NY pause applies before 2021-06-28 only. Holiday futures hours are separately provisional where date-specific primary confirmation is unavailable. March2020 circuit-breaker dates are flagged; missing halt bars are not filled or promoted into full390 eligibility.
expiry: Nominal quarterly third-Friday 09:30 NY termination is a diagnostic for the expiring contract, never a rollover rule. Source-date exceptions require explicit evidence.
roll: Reuse existing oos_preparation.adapter.determine_roll: sum observed vendor volume over each completed joint session, old endpoints cover expected grid, new endpoints within existing 60-minute tolerance, first new>old, effective next grid session. No calendar fallback. Independently disclose missing interior minutes, start-of-overlap censoring and provisional-calendar dependencies. Uncertified volume coverage blocks final independent-release readiness even if a candidate roll can be constructed. Last common 15:59 close before activation supplies causal additive spread; no future close or future volume.
